reason: Authorization bypass in ChromaDB's multi-tenant HTTP server (any authenticated user can read/write/delete another tenant's collection); no fix_version yet. Sidar only uses chromadb.PersistentClient (embedded, in-process, no server/RBAC layer) via core/rag/backends/chroma.py -- the vulnerable server/tenant code path is never reached. Re-verified 2026-09-25: core/rag/backends/chroma.py still only creates chromadb.PersistentClient; no chroma server image, HttpClient or RBAC provider exists in the repo, and chromadb 1.5.9 (latest) is still affected; next_review=2026-11-30.

SimpleRBACAuthorizationProvider fails to scope permission checks to tenant/database in ChromaDB's HTTP server; no fix_version yet. Same PersistentClient-only usage as CVE-2026-45830 above -- no RBAC provider is configured or reachable. Re-verified 2026-09-25: core/rag/backends/chroma.py still only creates chromadb.PersistentClient; no chroma server image, HttpClient or RBAC provider exists in the repo, and chromadb 1.5.9 (latest) is still affected; next_review=2026-11-30.

Code injection in ChromaDB's HTTP server via a malicious model-repository argument; no fix_version yet. Same PersistentClient-only usage as CVE-2026-45830 above -- no HTTP server is run, so the vulnerable ingestion path is never reached. Re-verified 2026-09-25: core/rag/backends/chroma.py still only creates chromadb.PersistentClient; no chroma server image, HttpClient or RBAC provider exists in the repo, and chromadb 1.5.9 (latest) is still affected; next_review=2026-11-30.

CVE-2026-81726 / GHSA-8mgp-746c-j5xp: dosya sandbox (pathsec) bypass in nltk model-artifact APIs (TransitionParser.train/parse, AveragedPerceptron.save/load, PerceptronTagger.save_to_json, save_maxent_params) letting caller-controlled paths read/write outside the configured pathsec root; no fix_version yet. Same root cause as PYSEC-2026-597 above: nltk is a transitive dependency of the dev-only `safety` tool (not used by first-party Sidar code) -- Sidar never imports nltk or calls any of the affected model-persistence APIs. Re-verified 2026-09-25: `uv tree --invert --package nltk` shows nltk only under `safety` (dev/ci extras) and no first-party module imports nltk; nltk 3.10.3 is the latest release and still affected; next_review=2026-11-30.
